errors.text: The required SRO finite-size boundary is not reconstructed: the target uses a 12x12x12, 3456-atom supercell, whereas the hypothesis only proposes an unspecified cell larger than 100 atoms.

The principal mediator is incorrectly narrowed to reproducing SRO-induced high-frequency VDOS features. The target mediator is broad reproduction of the DFT phase-space distribution, characterized by sub-meV/atom MTP errors and low variance of MTP-DFT energy differences.
The 0.5 meV/atom criterion applies to the free-energy difference between FEP and TI, not directly to melting-temperature agreement; the claimed equivalence to less than 10 K is unsupported.
